scope: Live learned-skill cooldown samples for native client hydration and initial PostgreSQL readiness.

source_authority.contract: SendCS_CHARINFO_ACK sends learned WORD skill ID, BYTE rank and GetReuseRemainTick(dwTick) DWORD sampled while constructing the packet.
Remaining reuse duration decreases from the local timer origin and clamps at zero.
Load restores persisted remaining duration on the current local clock; no offline decay is introduced.

implementation.charinfo: After CS_CHGCHANNEL_ACK completes, copy the hydrated character through the existing PersistenceSnapshot path at one steady-clock instant and encode the unchanged CHARINFO layout.
implementation.readiness: Before offloading MarkReady, sample live timers again into a private immutable input. Existing core/skill or full-graph transaction and receipt rules apply.
implementation.invariants: Samples do not rearm timers or replace the shared loaded payload. Learned IDs/ranks and timer origins remain unchanged. Expired skills have zero remaining duration.
implementation.failures: Missing tracker or active timer absent from the learned set closes before readiness; no stale CHARINFO or initial checkpoint is emitted for an invalid sample.
implementation.duplicates: Existing hydrated/ready phase gates prevent duplicate CHARINFO and repeated initial checkpoints.
implementation.migration: None. Backups and migrations 001-021 retain their hashes; next migration remains 022.

regression_before.expected_failure: Map runtime wire: delayed CONREADY persists elapsed long cooldown and expired short cooldown before gameplay
regression_before.scope: Prior installed daemon with current mounted backend integration executable and the same encrypted TCP checks.

targeted.scope: Plain/encrypted real TCP admission and pure client encoding: injected load-to-hydration clock, expired timer, delayed client readiness, unchanged loaded payload/origin, duplicate messages and missing/unknown tracker refusal.

native_wire_fixture.scope: Only disposable character skill rows are seeded. Reconnect and hard-crash recovery compare wire timers against persisted duration bounded by measured online admission time.

limitations: CHARINFO samples before encoding/enqueue, not at remote receipt; network and write-queue latency are not added to the protocol.
Readiness samples before database offload, not at transaction commit; later checkpoints continue the live countdown.
Active buff/effect/quest/recall timers, loop/cancellation and complete gameplay remain separate work.
No original client executable was run. Wire checks use encrypted source-derived synthetic peers.
Crash recovery retains the last committed timer sample; later unsaved time/state can be lost.
